entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I arrived at the Grand National Ass..."
entries.dialogueText: I arrived at the Grand National Assembly, which was only a five-minute drive away from the Palace.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Good to see you here, Mr. Rayne.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good to see you here, Mr. Rayne."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Today, I had a private meeting with..."
entries.dialogueText: Today, I had a private meeting with Gloria Tory, one of the leading figures of the USP, to get her approval for the proposal. She was also key in reaching 150 signatures to propose the new Constitution, as she had extensive control over our party's conservative and moderate wings.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I walked through the corridors o..."
entries.dialogueText: As I walked through the corridors of the Grand National Assembly, I was confronted by my memories of the historic building. Despite being a member of Assembly not long ago, it now felt like the distant past.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked into the left wing of the..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked into the left wing of the Assembly which currently acted as the quarters of the USP. Gloria's office was the first one inside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I knocked on the door and entered."
entries.dialogueText: I knocked on the door and entered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a small, neatly organised of..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a small, neatly organised office. There were small figurines, photos and plants around the place. It had a homey feel, unlike my own Assembly office when I had worked there.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On her gesture, I took a seat. The..."
entries.dialogueText: On her gesture, I took a seat. The chair was very uncomfortable.
